_comment: gateway-graphql-and-streaming-protocols (REQ-GQLP-001): an endpoint of targetType graphql forwards GraphQL over HTTP to its source after reading the operation; it refuses an operation outside allowedOperations, a query nested deeper than maxDepth, and introspection by a consumer unless introspection is on. The call log records the operation type and name of each proxied GraphQL call. Per-operation limits (operationLimits) are counted per caller with the consumer rate limiter (REQ-GQLP-001). An endpoint of targetType stream describes a WebSocket, gRPC or MQTT route that a web server or broker carries; integriq only answers POST /api/gateway/authorize for it and logs each connection with protocol and connectionId (REQ-GQLP-002).

allowedOperations.title: Allowed operations
allowedOperations.description: For a graphql endpoint: the operation names a consumer may run, such as zaakDetails. An operation not on the list, or one without a name, is refused with 403 before the source is called. Empty allows every operation.

maxDepth.title: Maximum query depth
maxDepth.description: For a graphql endpoint: how deep a query may nest its fields, fragments expanded. A deeper query is refused before the source is called. 0 sets no limit.

introspection.title: Allow introspection
introspection.description: For a graphql endpoint: whether a consumer may ask for the schema itself (__schema, __type). Administrators always may.

operationLimits.title: Per-operation limits
operationLimits.description: For a graphql endpoint: a rate limit per operation name, such as {"zakenLijst": {"requestsPerWindow": 60, "windowSeconds": 60}}, counted per consumer (or per client address without one). An operation past its limit gets a GraphQL error with 429 before the source is called.

streamProtocol.title: Stream protocol
streamProtocol.description: For a stream endpoint: the protocol the web server or broker carries. Integriq does not carry the traffic; it answers whether a caller may connect.

streamRoute.title: Public path or topic
streamRoute.description: For a stream endpoint: the public path the web server serves (a WebSocket path or a gRPC service path such as /zaken.v1.Zaken/; a trailing * matches everything below it), or for MQTT the topic filter (+ and # as in MQTT).

streamUpstream.title: Upstream
streamUpstream.description: For a stream endpoint: where the web server or broker sends the traffic, for the operator's reference. Integriq never connects to it.

allowedConsumers.title: Allowed consumers
allowedConsumers.description: For a stream endpoint: the consumers (by uuid) that may connect. Empty lets every consumer that holds the required scopes connect.

requiredScopes.title: Required scopes
requiredScopes.description: For a stream endpoint: the scopes a consumer must hold, all of them, to connect.

requestsPerWindow.title: Connections per window
requestsPerWindow.description: How many connections one consumer may open in a window.

windowSeconds.title: Window (seconds)
windowSeconds.description: How long the window lasts. The count starts again after it.

connectionRateLimit.title: Connection rate limit
connectionRateLimit.description: For a stream endpoint: how many connections one consumer may open per window. Past it the server is answered 429.

graphqlOperationType.title: GraphQL operation type
graphqlOperationType.description: For a call through a graphql endpoint: whether it ran a query, a mutation or a subscription.

graphqlOperationName.title: GraphQL operation
graphqlOperationName.description: For a call through a graphql endpoint: the name of the operation it ran; empty for an anonymous operation.

protocol.title: Protocol
protocol.description: For a connection a web server or broker asked about: the protocol it carries.

connectionId.title: Connection
connectionId.description: For a connection a web server or broker asked about: the id the server or broker gave the connection, when it sent one.
